sentiment.soxx_put_call_ratio_note: Above 1.2: elevated hedging/fear. Below 0.6: complacency. Range 0.6–1.2: neutral positioning.

technicals.source: Massive/Polygon daily bars — SOXX: RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), Bollinger Bands(20,2); constituents RSI(14): NVDA, AVGO, AMD, QCOM, INTC. Indicators computed locally with pandas.

valuation.soxx_pe_source_note: Finnhub /stock/metric — TTM P/E (peTTM) and annual P/B (pbAnnual). Trailing 12-month P/E — directionally comparable to forward P/E but not equivalent.

breadth.soxx_breadth_note: Below 40%: narrow/fragile rally. 40–70%: mixed participation. Above 70%: broad participation.
